title: pass_priority returns actions_passed=0 when pending_action_from_choose_action, trapping models in loop
description:
Models get stuck in a loop when they call choose_action(answer=false) to pass on a playable instant, then call pass_priority() to advance the game. pass_priority returns immediately with actions_passed=0 and stop_reason=pending_action_from_choose_action, so the game never advances.

This is a different variant from the bug fixed in #373 (pass_priority always pass once with playable cards). The #373 fix works when has_playable_cards is the stop reason, but not when pending_action_from_choose_action blocks it.

The model cycle is:
1. get_action_choices shows playable instant (e.g. Three Steps Ahead)
2. choose_action(answer=false) to pass
3. Result includes next_action_pending: true
4. Model calls pass_priority() to advance
5. pass_priority returns actions_passed=0, stop_reason=pending_action_from_choose_action
6. Model confused, eventually calls get_action_choices
7. Same instant offered again (new priority window)
8. Goto 1

Evidence:
- game_20260216_155314_g2: Gem25F Philo (gemini-2.5-flash) spent 28 of 86 LLM responses (33%) trapped in this loop with Three Steps Ahead. Model reasoning: "I find myself trapped in a recursive dance with the game engine, endlessly offered Three Steps Ahead while my hand yearns for land."
- game_20260216_155314_g4: Gem3P Sport (gemini-3-pro) reasoning: "Stuck in loop with next_action_pending: true", "big bug in my usage of pass_priority", "I might be stuck in a priority loop with myself?"

Both games are harness epoch 11, post-#373 fix.

Suggested fix: When pass_priority encounters pending_action_from_choose_action, resolve it (pass once) rather than returning immediately. Or: improve tool description to tell models never to call pass_priority when next_action_pending is true.
